data.name: Compare_BackToChanges

data.name: Compare_Baseline
data.comment: Section heading naming the version currently being compared against.

data.name: Compare_CellAt
data.comment: Position of a cell in the notebook. {0} is its number.

data.name: Compare_CellMoved
data.comment: Position of a moved cell. {0} is where it was, {1} is where it is now. Keep the arrow.

data.name: Compare_ChangeBaseline
data.comment: Button that returns to the list of versions to compare against.

data.name: Compare_Changes
data.comment: Section heading over the list of cells that differ.

data.name: Compare_CompareWith
data.comment: Section heading over the list of versions the notebook can be compared against.

data.name: Compare_CouldNotRun
data.comment: Body of that dialog. {0} is the reason, such as a missing baseline or a git error.

data.name: Compare_DialogTitle
data.comment: Title of the dialog shown when a comparison against another version of the notebook fails.

data.name: Compare_DirectoryUnresolved
data.value: Could not work out which folder '{0}' is in.
data.comment: Shown when a notebook's path could not be resolved before comparing. {0} is a path.

data.name: Compare_EmptyCell
data.comment: Stands in for the first line of a cell that has nothing in it. Keep the brackets, which mark it as a description rather than content.

data.name: Compare_FileMissing
data.comment: Shown when the file chosen as a baseline is not there. {0} is a path.

data.name: Compare_FileNotTracked
data.value: '{0}' is not tracked at '{1}'. Commit the file first, or pick a different ref.
data.comment: Shown when version control has no copy of the notebook at the chosen point. {0} is a file name and {1} is a branch, tag, or commit.

data.name: Compare_GitReadFailed
data.comment: Shown when version control failed for a reason Verso does not recognise. {0} is a file name, {1} is a branch, tag, or commit, and “git” is a product name.

data.name: Compare_GitRefLabel
data.comment: Names the baseline in a comparison against version control. {0} is a branch, tag, or commit.

data.name: Compare_LookingForBaselines
data.comment: Shown while Verso works out which earlier versions it can offer. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Compare_NoCellChanged
data.value: No cell changed against this baseline.
data.comment: Shown when the two versions hold the same cells.

data.name: Compare_NotInGitRepo
data.value: The notebook file is not inside a git repository.
data.comment: Why a comparison against version control is not available. “git” is a product name and is not translated.

data.name: Compare_NotSavedYet
data.value: The notebook has not been saved to a file yet.
data.comment: Why a comparison against the saved copy is not available.

data.name: Compare_NotSet
data.comment: Stands in for a notebook property that had no value on one side of the comparison. Keep the brackets.

data.name: Compare_NotebookSettings
data.comment: Section heading over the notebook's own properties that differ, such as its title or default kernel.

data.name: Compare_NothingYet
data.value: Nothing is being compared yet. The notebook is untouched either way.
data.comment: Reassurance under an empty baseline list. Comparing never modifies the notebook.

data.name: Compare_OpenFullDiff
data.comment: Button that opens the side-by-side view of both versions.

data.name: Compare_ParseFailed
data.value: Could not read '{0}' as a notebook: {1}

data.name: Compare_SourceChooseFile
data.comment: Opens a box for typing the path of another notebook. Keep the three dots, which mean a question follows.

data.name: Compare_SourceGitHead

data.name: Compare_SourceLastSaved
data.comment: One of the things a notebook can be compared against: the copy currently on disk.

data.comment: Chip summarising a comparison. {0} is how many cells are new.

data.comment: Chip summarising a comparison. {0} is how many cells changed position.

data.name: Compare_SummaryRemoved
data.comment: Chip summarising a comparison. {0} is how many cells are gone.

data.name: Compare_SummaryUnchanged
data.comment: Chip summarising a comparison. {0} is how many cells are the same.

data.name: Compare_UnknownRef
data.value: '{0}' is not a known branch, tag, or commit.
data.comment: Shown when what was typed does not name anything in version control. {0} is what was typed.

data.name: Compare_WasCell
data.comment: Position of a removed cell, which no longer exists here. {0} is its number in the baseline.

data.name: Output_Error
data.comment: Heading over a cell's error output when the error carried no name of its own.

data.name: Output_JsonItems_One
data.comment: Summary of a collapsed JSON list holding exactly one entry. {0} is the number.

data.name: Output_JsonItems_Other
data.comment: Summary of a collapsed JSON list. {0} is how many entries it holds.

data.name: Output_JsonKeys_One
data.comment: Summary of a collapsed JSON object holding exactly one entry. {0} is the number.

data.name: Output_JsonKeys_Other
data.comment: Summary of a collapsed JSON object. {0} is how many entries it holds.

data.name: Output_RenderFailed
data.value: This output could not be rendered
data.comment: Heading of the notice that replaces an output the interface could not draw.

data.name: Output_RetryRender
data.comment: Tooltip on the button that tries to draw that output again.

data.name: Output_StandardError
data.comment: Accessible name of the block holding what a cell wrote to standard error. Read aloud by a screen reader.

data.name: Output_Working
data.comment: Label on a progress bar whose sender gave it no wording of its own.

data.name: Panel_Collapse
data.comment: Button that closes the open side panel. Also its label for screen readers and its tooltip.

data.name: Panel_Compare
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel for measuring the notebook against a baseline.

data.name: Panel_Compare_Description
data.value: Measure this notebook against a saved baseline.
data.comment: Second line of the Compare toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_Extensions
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel listing extensions.

data.name: Panel_Extensions_Description
data.value: Extensions loaded here, and more you can install.
data.comment: Second line of the Extensions toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_Metadata
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel holding the notebook's own details.

data.name: Panel_Metadata_Description
data.value: Title, kernel, and file details for this notebook.
data.comment: Second line of the Metadata toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_NothingToShow
data.value: This panel has nothing to show.
data.comment: Shown in a panel contributed by an extension when it rendered nothing.

data.name: Panel_Properties
data.comment: Toggle of the panel holding the selected cell's settings. Its heading is longer; see Panel_PropertiesHeading.

data.name: Panel_PropertiesHeading
data.comment: Heading over the open properties panel. Longer than the toggle beside it, which has no room to say which properties.

data.name: Panel_Properties_Description
data.comment: Second line of the Properties toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_Settings
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel holding extension settings.

data.name: Panel_Settings_Description
data.value: Settings contributed by the enabled extensions.
data.comment: Second line of the Settings toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_Variables
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel listing what the kernel is holding.

data.name: Panel_Variables_Description
data.value: Everything the kernel is currently holding.
data.comment: Second line of the Variables toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Panel_View
data.comment: Toggle and heading of the panel for switching layout or theme.

data.name: Panel_View_Description
data.value: Switch layout or theme without closing the panel.
data.comment: Second line of the View toggle's tooltip, saying what the panel holds.

data.name: Properties_AddTagPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the field that adds a tag to a cell. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Properties_None
data.value: No properties available for this cell.
data.comment: Shown in the Properties panel when the selected cell has nothing to configure.

data.name: Properties_RemoveTag
data.comment: Tooltip on the small cross beside a tag in the Properties panel.

data.name: Properties_SelectACell
data.value: Select a cell to view its properties.
data.comment: Shown in the Properties panel when no cell is selected.

data.name: Reconnect_Message
data.value: Your session is still active. Attempting to reconnect.
data.comment: Under the “Reconnecting” heading, reassuring the reader that nothing has been lost.

data.name: Reconnect_RecoveringMessage
data.comment: Under the “Recovering your session” heading.

data.name: Reconnect_RecoveringTitle
data.comment: Heading on the overlay once reconnection has been given up on and the page is about to reload. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Reconnect_Reload
data.comment: Button on the reconnection overlay that loads the page again.

data.name: Reconnect_Title
data.comment: Heading on the overlay shown when the browser loses its connection to Verso. Keep the three dots.

data.name: SaveDialog_PathHint
data.value: Enter the full file path. The {0} extension will be added if missing.
data.comment: Under the file path box. {0} is the literal text “.verso”, drawn in a code style and not translated.

data.name: SaveDialog_PathLabel
data.comment: Label above the box where a file path is typed. Keep the colon if your language uses one.

data.name: SaveDialog_Title
data.comment: Title of the dialog that asks where to write the notebook.

data.name: Settings_CategoryGeneral
data.comment: Heading over settings an extension did not file under any category of its own.

data.name: Settings_ListPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in a setting that takes several values. Tells the reader how to separate them. Lower case, it sits inside the field.

data.name: Settings_NoConfigurableExtensions
data.value: No enabled extensions with configurable settings.
data.comment: Shown in the Settings panel when nothing that is switched on has anything to configure.

data.name: Status_KernelRestarted
data.comment: Brief confirmation after the language kernel was restarted.

data.name: Status_KernelRestartedReload
data.value: Kernel restarted. Re-run cells with #!nuget or #!extension to reload.
data.comment: Shown after a restart when the notebook has cells that load packages. The two commands are literal and must not be translated.

data.name: Status_LayoutNotLoaded
data.value: Layout '{0}' is not loaded. Run the cell containing #!extension or #!nuget to load it.
data.comment: Shown when a notebook asks for a layout its extension has not loaded. {0} is the layout's identifier. The two commands are literal and must not be translated.

data.name: Status_RequiredExtensionUnavailable_One
data.value: Required extension {0} could not be loaded. Some layouts or cells may not work until it is available.
data.comment: Shown when the one extension a notebook requires is missing. {0} is a package name.

data.name: Status_RequiredExtensionUnavailable_Other
data.value: {0} required extensions could not be loaded: {1}. Some layouts or cells may not work until they are available.
data.comment: Shown when several extensions a notebook requires are missing. {0} is how many, {1} is their names.

data.name: Status_RestartingKernel
data.comment: Shown for as long as the language kernel is restarting. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Status_Saved
data.comment: Brief confirmation after writing the notebook, shown for a few seconds.

data.name: Status_SavedTo
data.comment: Brief confirmation after writing the notebook. {0} is a file name.

data.name: Toolbar_ActionFailed
data.comment: Error banner after a toolbar button did not work. {0} is the button's name and {1} is the underlying reason, which stays in English.

data.name: Toolbar_Browse
data.comment: Button that opens the system file picker instead of typing a path.

data.name: Toolbar_CellCount_One
data.comment: Beside the notebook name when it holds exactly one cell. {0} is the number.

data.name: Toolbar_CellCount_Other
data.comment: Beside the notebook name. {0} is how many cells it holds.

data.name: Toolbar_Export
data.comment: Label on the Export menu button. Keep short, a menu arrow follows it.

data.name: Toolbar_ExportNotebook
data.comment: Tooltip on the Export menu.

data.name: Toolbar_Go
data.comment: Button that opens whatever was typed in the path field. Keep very short.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelDisconnected
data.comment: Kernel status. The kernel process is gone and nothing can run.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelError
data.comment: Kernel status. Something went wrong in the kernel itself, not in a cell.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelIdle
data.comment: Kernel status. Ready and waiting, nothing running.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelList
data.comment: Tooltip on a notebook using several languages. {0} is their names, separated by commas.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelRestarting
data.comment: Kernel status. The kernel is starting again and will lose its variables.

data.name: Toolbar_KernelRunning
data.comment: Kernel status. A cell is executing. Keep the single ellipsis character.

data.name: Toolbar_New
data.comment: Toolbar button label. Creates a new notebook. Keep short, it sits next to an icon.

data.name: Toolbar_NewNotebook
data.comment: Tooltip for the New toolbar button.

data.name: Toolbar_NoKernel
data.comment: Shown where the kernel name goes when the notebook names no language to run.

data.name: Toolbar_Open
data.comment: Toolbar button label. Opens an existing notebook. Keep short, it sits next to an icon.

data.name: Toolbar_OpenFile
data.comment: Tooltip for the Open toolbar button.

data.name: Toolbar_OpenPathPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the field that opens a notebook. It takes either. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Toolbar_ReadFileFailed
data.comment: Error shown when a chosen file could not be read. {0} is the reason.

data.name: Toolbar_Save
data.comment: Toolbar button label and its tooltip. Keep short, it sits next to an icon.

data.name: Toolbar_SaveUnsavedChanges
data.comment: Second tooltip line on the Save button, shown only when the notebook is dirty.

data.name: Toolbar_StopExecution
data.comment: Tooltip on the button that appears in place of Run while a cell is running.

data.name: Toolbar_StopFailed
data.comment: Error shown when cancelling a running cell did not work. {0} is the reason.

data.name: Variables_ColumnName
data.comment: Column heading in the Variables panel. What the variable is called.

data.name: Variables_ColumnType
data.comment: Column heading in the Variables panel. The variable's data type.

data.name: Variables_ColumnValue
data.comment: Column heading in the Variables panel. A short preview of what the variable holds.

data.name: Variables_Empty
data.comment: Shown in the Variables panel when the kernel is holding nothing yet.

data.name: Variables_Refresh
data.comment: Tooltip on the button that asks the kernel for the current variables rather than reading what was last seen.

data.name: Variables_RefreshFailed
data.comment: Shown in the Variables panel when the kernel could not be asked. {0} is the reason.

data.name: View_Layout
data.comment: Section heading in the View panel, over the list of ways the notebook can be arranged.

data.name: View_ReadOnly
data.comment: Small chip beside a layout that shows the notebook without letting anyone edit it. Keep very short.

data.name: View_Theme
data.comment: Section heading in the View panel, over the list of colour schemes.

data.name: Welcome_Intro
data.value: Create a new notebook or open an existing {0}, {1}, or {2} file to get started.
data.comment: The welcome screen's one line of guidance. {0}, {1}, and {2} are file extensions drawn in a code style and not translated.

data.name: Welcome_WaitingForContent
data.comment: Shown beside a spinner while the editor waits for a notebook to arrive. Keep the three dots.

data.name: Widget_FrameTitle
data.comment: Accessible name of the frame a widget draws itself in. Read aloud by a screen reader.

data.name: Widget_InertNotice
data.value: Showing saved state. Run the cell to make this widget live.
data.comment: Note under a widget that has no kernel behind it. Read aloud by a screen reader, and shown as text beneath the widget.
